name: prompt-input
purpose: The composer of a chat or assistant: an auto-growing text field where Enter sends and Shift+Enter adds a line (or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends), attachments by button, paste, or drop with type, size, and count limits, a character or token counter hook, a Send button that becomes Stop while a reply streams, and an optional suggestions popup for slash commands or mentions. A form control with label, help text, and validation.
whenToUse: Writing a message or prompt to an assistant, a support agent, or a colleague.
A short text that is sent rather than saved, with optional files.
Commands or mentions picked from a list while typing (slash commands, @mentions).
whenNotToUse: Long form text that is saved with a form: use Textarea.
Formatted text: use Rich Text Editor.
responsive: Full width of its container. The field grows with its content between `rows` and `maxRows`, then scrolls. Attachment chips wrap; long file names are cut with an ellipsis.
rtl: Logical properties throughout; the toolbar and chips mirror, and the send icon mirrors with the writing direction.
theme: Component tokens prompt-input-bg, -border-color, -radius, and -padding-x (falling back to the control field roles). Focus shows on the whole box (ring plus border color). Forced-colors mode draws a Highlight outline on focus and Highlight for the active suggestion.
security: Label, help text, file names, suggestions, and messages are rendered with textContent. Attached files are never read or uploaded by the component; the host receives them in `aui-send`. Auto-grow writes block-size through the CSSOM (style.setProperty), never a style attribute. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry. Files stay in memory until sent, removed, or the component is destroyed.

performance.testedScale: Values up to 100,000 characters; up to 100 attachments; up to 50 suggestions shown.

limitations: The token counter is a hook: AbsoluteUI ships no tokenizer.
Suggestions open above the field inside the component; they are not in the top layer, so an ancestor with overflow hidden can clip them.
Without native `field-sizing` support, auto-grow measures on input and on render only.
unsupported: Rich text, inline images, or HTML in the field.
Voice input (the host can add a button next to the component).
Uploading files: the host uploads what `aui-send` delivers.
antiPatterns: Hiding the label without a visible heading or placeholder that explains the field.
Using Enter to send in a field where users write long multi-paragraph text: use submitKey 'mod-enter'.
Disabling the field while a reply streams: users should be able to write the next message.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/prompt-input: AuiPromptInput component (<aui-prompt-input>) with ControlValueAccessor and Validator.
adapters.react: @absoluteui/react/prompt-input: AuiPromptInput component; controlled (value/defaultValue + onValueChange) or uncontrolled.
